thread:
maria: Quick sync request 1: marketplace private listing for a hardware partner. They want to support BYO-HSM and integrate SCIM for provisioning support engineers. Can we sketch requirements before Thursday?
leo: Happy to help. High level: (1) attestation flow (vendor-signed certs or TPM quote), (2) runtime mapping (PKCS#11 vs Cloud KMS), (3) packaging for private offers (container + manifest), (4) SCIM + SAML pre-provisioning steps.
anya: For attestation, recommend two options: soft path (signed CSR + ownership doc) and strong path (remote attestation). We'll need to list accepted attestation formats.
priya: Ops ask: what does "manifest" need to contain? My initial list: image URI, exposed ports, env vars (KMS_ENDPOINT, HSM_SLOT, TLS cert path), minimum CPU/memory, healthcheck endpoint, and required host capabilities (e.g., /dev/sgx).
leo: Good list. Also include required IAM role bindings and cloud marketplace metadata (support contact, allowed data regions).
maria: From product/GTM: we must decide whether the private listing will be "redwood-verified" or "partner-managed". Verification requires us to run the attestation and smoke tests during onboarding.
anya: Smoke-test idea: run SoftHSM in a container and execute a pairing flow: 1) list tokens, 2) sign a short payload, 3) exchange signed cert to our attestation verifier. Example commands: ```docker run --rm -v /tmp/softhsm:/var/lib/softhsm2 -e SOFTHSM2_CONF=/etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf deplike/softhsm pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L && echo "test" | openssl dgst -sha256 -sign private_key.pem | base64```
ops-bot: Reminder: include log-forwarding endpoints and minimum audit retention (90 days) in the manifest.
priya: Noted. Also legal-bot flagged export-control checks for TEE/HSM shipping. Will loop in legal if the partner hardware crosses jurisdictions.
maria: Let's assign owners: anya = attestation options + smoke-test scripts, leo = runtime mapping doc (PKCS11 <> cloud-KMS equivalents), priya = manifest template + ops checklist, maria = GTM policy + verification criteria. We'll do a 45-min working session tomorrow to draft the artifacts.
leo: Can we add a short SCIM playbook? E.g., endpoints we expect, attribute mapping (userName, externalId, active, emails), and example PATCH payload. I'll draft a one-pager.
anya: Also add a tiny SAML checklist: SP metadata exchange, required attributes (name, email, groups), and test plan (IdP test account + assertion sample).
maria: Perfect. If everyone can upload a short draft to the shared folder by EOD today, we can iterate in the session. Folder: https://docs.internal/partners/marketplace-private-hsm
priya: Will do. Also adding a quick manifest example to the folder: ```{
  "image": "gcr.io/partner/hsm-adapter:1.0",
  "ports": [8443],
  "env": ["KMS_ENDPOINT","HSM_SLOT","SCIM_BASE"],
  "healthcheck": "/healthz",
  "audit_retention_days": 90
}```
maria: Thank you. Final note 1: please keep the list of supported HSM models small initially (3 vendors) to reduce verification burden. We'll expand later.
legal-bot: Noted: legal will request proof of indemnity for third-party HW integration and a network isolation plan for private listings.
leo: Great. See you in the working session. :calendar:
